description: Canonical machine-readable telemetry contract for Nexova material inventory. Business-metric events feed the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Support events are operational only and are not weekly-report KPI inputs. See memory-bank/documentation/telemetry-CONTEXT.md and memory-bank/documentation/data-pipeline-CONTEXT.md.

userId.description: TinyDB user UUID for the authenticated operator.

requestId.description: Correlation id spanning UI and API work for a single operation.

properties.description: Event payload limited to the event allowlist.

supersededEvents.description: HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED — not used for Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Replaced by inbound_order_created; inbound events must include unit_cost (and may include total_cost).
HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED — not used for Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Replaced by outbound_order_created for Kits Delivered.
HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED — not used for Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Former procurement failure signal; not a weekly KPI input.
HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED — not used for Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Former assignment failure signal; not a weekly KPI input.
HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED — not used for Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Former assignment lead-time start signal.
HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED — not used for Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Former assignment UX friction signal.

events.description: Mandatory business-metric event. A new batch of training or onboarding material arrived from a supplier (InboundOrder created). Feeds Material Cost per Office/Programme for the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report.
events.hypothesis: We need to know how much material is being produced or purchased, for which programme, and at what cost.
events.business_decision: Plan material production based on expected enrolment demand (Elena) and track L&D investment by office and programme (Laura).
events.pii_strategy: Use opaque operator UUIDs only in envelope. Never put candidate, client, consultant, or agent names in properties.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value: valencia | miami.

properties.name: product_id
properties.description: Stable product / material identifier.

properties.name: product_category
properties.description: Canonical product category enum: training_kit | certification | onboarding_equipment.

properties.name: programme_id
properties.description: Training or certification programme identifier (e.g. b2b-sales).

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Inbound quantity received.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Office local currency: EUR | USD. Do not convert at telemetry layer.

properties.name: unit_cost
properties.description: Unit cost of the material in the office local currency. Required for Material Cost aggregation.

properties.name: total_cost
properties.description: Optional total cost (typically unit_cost * quantity) in the office local currency.

properties.name: inbound_order_id
properties.description: Created InboundOrder identifier when available.

properties.name: supplier
properties.description: Supplier or vendor name only; no contact PII.

properties.name: created_by
properties.description: Opaque operator UUID.

events.description: Mandatory business-metric event. A kit or certificate was delivered to a client, candidate, consultant, or agent (OutboundOrder created). Feeds Kits Delivered for the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report.
events.hypothesis: We need to know which programmes consume the most material, and at what rate.
events.business_decision: Anticipate restocking needs before a large enrolment wave (Elena) and measure adoption by office and programme (Laura).
events.pii_strategy: Never include recipient names. Use programme_id and product identifiers only; operator UUID in envelope or created_by.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value: valencia | miami.

properties.name: product_id
properties.description: Stable product / material identifier.

properties.name: product_category
properties.description: Canonical product category enum: training_kit | certification | onboarding_equipment.

properties.name: programme_id
properties.description: Training or certification programme identifier.

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Delivered quantity.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Office local currency: EUR | USD. Present for dimensional consistency across material events.

properties.name: outbound_order_id
properties.description: Created OutboundOrder identifier when available.

properties.name: created_by
properties.description: Opaque operator UUID.

events.description: Mandatory business-metric event. Stock of a material item fell below the configured minimum after a stock-changing operation. Feeds Shortage Frequency for the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report.
events.hypothesis: We need to know how often a programme runs out of available material.
events.business_decision: Adjust the minimum threshold or speed up reprinting/reproduction of that material (Elena).

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value: valencia | miami.

properties.name: product_id
properties.description: Product identifier whose stock crossed the threshold.

properties.name: product_category
properties.description: Canonical product category enum: training_kit | certification | onboarding_equipment.

properties.name: programme_id
properties.description: Programme identifier for the material.

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Current stock quantity after the triggering operation (or remaining quantity at breach).

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Office local currency: EUR | USD. Present for dimensional consistency.

properties.name: current_stock
properties.description: Available stock after the stock-changing operation (alias of quantity when both are used).

properties.name: min_stock_threshold
properties.description: Configured minimum / reorder threshold for the product.

properties.name: trigger_source_event
properties.description: Source event that caused the threshold breach, usually outbound_order_created.

properties.name: trigger_source_order_id
properties.description: Identifier of the order that caused the threshold breach.

events.description: Mandatory business-metric event. A user attempted to modify stock directly (outside an InboundOrder or OutboundOrder) and the system rejected it. Required for material traceability integrity monitoring; not one of the four v1 weekly KPI aggregation columns.
events.hypothesis: We need to know if staff are attempting to bypass material traceability controls.
events.business_decision: Reinforce training or permissions at the office where this happens most (Patricia).
events.pii_strategy: Use operator UUID only. Do not capture raw request payloads or person names.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value: valencia | miami.

properties.name: product_id
properties.description: Product identifier when known.

properties.name: product_category
properties.description: Canonical product category enum: training_kit | certification | onboarding_equipment.

properties.name: programme_id
properties.description: Programme identifier for the material when known.

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Attempted stock quantity when supplied.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Office local currency: EUR | USD when known.

properties.name: attempted_operation
properties.description: Blocked operation such as direct_stock_patch.

properties.name: rejection_reason
properties.description: Reason code such as stock_mutation_requires_order.

events.description: Mandatory business-metric event. The unit cost of an inbound order varies more than a configured threshold (e.g. 10%) from the historical value for that material/supplier. Feeds Cost Variance Frequency for the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report.
events.hypothesis: We need to know when a material supplier raises prices abnormally.
events.business_decision: Alert Elena and Laura to renegotiate or find an alternate supplier.
events.pii_strategy: No direct PII. Cost figures only; no personal names.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value: valencia | miami.

properties.name: product_id
properties.description: Product identifier with the cost variance.

properties.name: product_category
properties.description: Canonical product category enum: training_kit | certification | onboarding_equipment.

properties.name: programme_id
properties.description: Programme identifier for the material.

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Inbound quantity associated with the cost observation.

properties.name: currency
properties.description: Office local currency: EUR | USD. Do not convert at telemetry layer.

properties.name: unit_cost
properties.description: New inbound unit cost that triggered the variance.

properties.name: previous_unit_cost
properties.description: Historical unit cost used as the baseline comparison.

properties.name: variance_ratio
properties.description: Relative change versus historical unit cost (e.g. 0.12 for +12%).

properties.name: variance_threshold
properties.description: Configured threshold that was exceeded (e.g. 0.10 for 10%).

properties.name: supplier
properties.description: Supplier name only when available; no contact PII.

properties.name: inbound_order_id
properties.description: InboundOrder identifier associated with the variance when available.

events.description: SUPPORT TELEMETRY — not an input to the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Operator opened the material/asset list view.
events.hypothesis: The material list is the main operational entry point and should be segmented by office.
events.business_decision: Decide how operators enter inventory workflows and whether office-specific workflows dominate.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Office filter value at first view if one is applied: valencia | miami.

properties.name: result_count
properties.description: Number of products/assets visible to the operator.

properties.name: view_source
properties.description: Entry source such as nav_menu or redirect_after_login.

events.description: SUPPORT TELEMETRY — not an input to the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Operator changed the office filter on the material/asset list.
events.hypothesis: Frequent office switching indicates centralized vs office-specific inventory oversight.
events.business_decision: Decide whether inventory UX should default to a single office or support multi-office operators.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value selected by the filter (valencia | miami), or all when cleared.

properties.name: previous_office
properties.description: Previous canonical office filter value when known.

properties.name: result_count
properties.description: Number of products/assets visible after the filter is applied.

events.description: SUPPORT TELEMETRY — not an input to the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Operator successfully authenticated into the backoffice.
events.hypothesis: Successful logins establish whether inventory friction starts after operators can reach the product.
events.business_decision: Decide whether access health is healthy enough to attribute inventory delays to workflow rather than auth.
events.pii_strategy: Use envelope userId UUID only. Do not capture email or password.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Preferred office when known at login time: valencia | miami.

events.description: SUPPORT TELEMETRY — not an input to the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. Operator failed to authenticate into the backoffice.
events.hypothesis: Failed logins reveal whether operators are blocked before inventory work begins.
events.business_decision: Decide whether credential recovery or auth UX needs improvement.
events.pii_strategy: No raw email. Normalized reason only.

properties.name: failure_reason
properties.description: Normalized reason such as invalid_credentials or network_error.

events.description: SUPPORT TELEMETRY — not an input to the Weekly Office & Programme Performance Report. An authenticated session was cleared after an unauthorized API response.
events.hypothesis: Mid-workflow session expiry disrupts inventory completion.
events.business_decision: Decide whether token lifetime or refresh UX should change.
events.pii_strategy: Use envelope userId UUID only when still available before token clear.
